primary.version: Current PC release with final content updates
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it has the complete game with the major free content updates, including Advanced Gungeons & Draguns and A Farewell to Arms, while preserving PC capture/settings flexibility. Console, mobile, Stadia, Mac, and Linux routes are documented access routes, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over PC is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Enter the Gungeon on Steam, GOG, Humble, Epic Games Store, or the official site for Windows PC and play the current patched build.

entries.title: Enter the Gungeon: House of the Gundead

emulation.notes: Use the dedicated cabinet; no general home emulation route is documented.

primary.why: House of the Gundead is an arcade-exclusive light-gun spin-off, so the dedicated cabinet is the primary and only sourced complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on the official dedicated arcade cabinet in an arcade/location that has the machine, or on a privately owned cabinet.
